newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX seat auctioned for record $585,000.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX seat auctioned for record $585,000.

text.p: A NYMEX division seat sold for a record $585,000 on December 17, the highest level ever reached.
The sale broke the previous record of $575,000 for a seat from the July 24, 1995 sale and the November 26 sale of this year.
NYMEX said the sale made the seat the second most valuable futures seat in the U.S., following the Chicago Board of Trade's recent $640,001 sale.

"I cannot think of a more auspicious way to enter our 125th anniversary year, which will also incorporate our move to a state-of-the-art facility in the World Financial Center," said NYMEX Chairman Daniel Rapaport in a release. He was referring the move planned for 1997 out out the Exchange's current home in the World Trade Center.
